resources.string: Remove various restrictions from Xiaomi Security Center. Covers charging protection (night / general / pogo / fast charge / bypass), performance & power (battery saver / ultra saver / throttle / thermal), system & background (AppOps / background kill / autostart), plus root live monitoring and persistent system-level overrides.
Please verify: 1) This module is enabled in LSPosed; 2) Scope includes "Security Service"; 3) The Security Service process has been restarted.
Connected to framework but cannot access RemotePreferences. Check if your LSPosed version supports the modern API.
Root unavailable, cannot read sysfs or system properties
Persistent Override (stays after module is disabled)

Uses root to write "disable charging protection" directly into system properties and Settings. Once applied, protection checks fail at the source — restrictions won\'t return even if this module is disabled or uninstalled. Original values are backed up automatically.
When disabled, all Hook interventions stop immediately. The target app does not need to restart. Persistent system-level changes are not affected.
Blocks NightChargeProtectManager.C() and M() so night charging protection never starts. Recommended.
Blocks setNightChargingState(1) to prevent other paths from re-enabling night charge protection.
General Charging Protection (heat / nav / prolonged / controller / always)
Blocks hg.a.l(true) master gate — all 7 protection policies are disabled. Only one implementation exists in the entire codebase.
Completely blocks e.n() / e.p() from issuing smart_chg protection bits.
When set to 100, no limit is issued. Other values rewrite the protection threshold to that percentage.
Protection triggered when charging via dock/pogo pins and battery is above 79%%, blocks gh.e enable action.
Force-clears the smart_chg 0x80 silent bit, restoring full wireless charging power.
Blocks PowerSaverProvider.call for performance / battery saver / ultra saver switching. Query calls still pass through.
Ultra saver triggers a chain: disabling apps, killing background, freezing autostart, zeroing animations, restricting notifications & status bar. Blocking the entry disables all of these at once.
Prevents battery saver from locking refresh rate to 60Hz, lowering brightness, and shortening screen timeout.
Prevents thermal config from being applied, avoiding forced CPU/GPU frequency reduction at high temperatures.
Allows ops 10048 (install), 10049 (chain start), 10050 (device ID), 10041 (screen record), 119 (accessibility), 10054/10055 (AI screen read/control).
Prevents one-tap clean from killing background processes and removing recent tasks.
Autostart restriction uses the platform permission library, not Settings or AppOps, so standard methods don\'t work.
Force enable also bypasses capability checks, for devices where fast charging doesn\'t activate due to missing whitelist or property.
Bypass Charging (direct power while plugged in)
Bypass charging pauses battery charging and powers the motherboard directly.
Intercepts jh.c.p() return value. 4 is best. Only affects display and level checks, not raw SOH data.
Log TAG: MeowPower. Use logcat -s MeowPower to view.

Config changes take effect immediately — no need to restart the target app.
After first enabling the module or updating its code, restart the Security Service process.
Persistent overrides don't depend on the module running and remain effective after disabling it.

This module only modifies local device behavior and does not upload any data.
Please enable this module in LSPosed, include "Security Service" in the scope, then restart that process.
When off, all Hook interventions stop immediately

When off, this module no longer intercepts anything and the target app returns to stock behavior. Persistent overrides written to system properties and Settings are not affected and must be restored separately.
Night charge protection won\'t start, no more stuck at 80%%
The main entry for night charging protection. Once active it makes the firmware hold charge at 80%%. Blocking it prevents the entire chain from starting, including the resume-charging alarm.
Prevent other paths from re-enabling protection
Night charge protection ultimately relies on setNightChargingState(1). Even if protection is started via another path, this block prevents it from actually issuing the restriction.
The shared gate for 7 charging protections: night, navigation, high-temp, prolonged, controller, always-on. Only one implementation exists — blocking it disables all of them.

General protection (high-temp / navigation / prolonged) issues smart_chg bits: upper 16 bits are the limit percentage (default 80%%), lower 16 bits are the protection type. Blocking it stops all protection commands.
Rewrites the protection limit threshold. 100 means no limit is issued; 50–99 rewrites the threshold to that percentage.
When off, restores stock threshold logic

When off, the general protection limit percentage is not rewritten and the stock threshold (default 80%%) is used. When on, it is rewritten to the slider value; 100 skips the protection call entirely.
Protection triggered above 79%% while dock charging
Triggered when charging via pogo dock / contact pins and battery exceeds 79%%. Designed to prevent prolonged full-charge while docked.
Wireless silent charging reduces wireless charging power (smart_chg 0x80 bit). Enabling this removes the limit and charges at full power.
Force-overrides the fast charge switch and capability check. "Force enable" also bypasses whitelist and property checks, for devices that support fast charging but can\'t activate it.

Bypass charging pauses battery charging and powers the motherboard directly. "Block auto-enable" prevents charging from stopping during use; "Block auto-disable" prevents the mode from being turned off mid-session.
Intercepts the battery health level return value (1–4, 4 is best). Only affects display and level checks, does not change raw SOH data.
Only changes the percentage shown on the charging protection page. Leave empty to skip. Tap OK to save and restart Security Service.
Performance / saver / ultra saver can\'t switch
The master gate for performance, battery saver, and ultra battery saver mode switching. When blocked, none of the three modes can be activated; status queries still pass through for display purposes.
Remove the cascade of ultra saver restrictions

Ultra battery saver triggers a chain: disabling apps, killing on lock screen, freezing autostart & wake paths, zeroing animations, restricting notifications & status bar, touch degradation. Blocking the entry disables everything at once.
Refresh rate no longer locked to 60Hz
In battery saver mode the system: locks refresh rate to 60Hz (the main cause of perceived lag in saver mode), lowers brightness, and shortens screen timeout. Enabling this prevents all three.
No forced downclocking at high temps

When temperature rises the system writes thermal profiles to persist.sys.thermal.config and kernel node /sys/class/thermal/thermal_message/sconfig to limit CPU/GPU frequency. Enabling this prevents the write.

MIUI\'s 7 private restrictions: 10048 block app install, 10049 block chain start, 10050 restrict device ID reading, 10041 screen recording protection, 119 accessibility restriction, 10054/10055 restrict AI screen reading & control.
One-tap clean no longer kills processes
One-tap clean calls killBackgroundProcesses to kill background processes, batch-kills process IDs, and removes apps from the recent tasks list. Enabling this stops all of these.

Autostart restriction is set via PERM_ID_AUTOSTART in the platform permission library (deny = 1, allow = 3), not via Settings or AppOps, so standard methods don\'t work. The system also kills the app\'s process when autostart is denied.
Allow all WiFi / mobile data access

Per-app network access control: WiFi and mobile data are separate, mobile data further split by SIM slot. Rules come from manual settings and system presets. Enabling this allows all apps to access the network.
Background apps can access network normally
The system restricts background network access per-app UID to save power, plus a global switch. Enabling this allows background network access.
Network won\'t auto-disconnect when data runs out
When mobile data allowance is used up, the system turns off the mobile data switch, causing a sudden disconnect. Enabling this prevents auto-disconnection — monitor your usage manually.
Hotspot won\'t stop when limit is reached
When hotspot data reaches its limit, the system turns off the hotspot and shows a notification. Enabling this prevents the interruption.

During installation, the APK signature digest is compared against a whitelist (Xiaomi official signatures or previously recorded ones). Mismatch aborts the install. Third-party installers and self-signed apps are commonly blocked by this.
Uses root to write "disable protection" into system properties and Settings. Even after disabling or uninstalling this module, restrictions won\'t return. Original values are backed up automatically.
When enabled, every interception is logged. Use logcat -s MeowPower to view. Turn on when troubleshooting, keep off otherwise.

Config changes take effect immediately — no need to restart the target app.
After first enabling the module or updating its code, restart the Security Service process.
Persistent overrides don't depend on the module running and remain effective after disabling it.
